entities.summary: The State Audiovisual Archives of Serbia – Yugoslav Film Archives is a cinematheque located in Belgrade, Serbia. Founded in 1949 as the national film archives of the Yugoslavia it currently serves as the national film depository of Serbia. Тhe Yugoslav Cinematheque is among the 10 largest film archives in the world.
